projects.title: Vantage: Magnetic-Wheel Lamppost-Climbing Surveillance Robot
projects.shortDesc: Ongoing magnetic-wheel robot built to ascend lampposts and stream live surveillance video, developed with 15C4I and the Singapore Police Force (SPF).
projects.fullDesc:
Vantage is an ongoing robotics project developed in collaboration with 15C4I and the Singapore Police Force (SPF), built around a magnetic-wheel platform designed to climb lampposts and stream live surveillance video from height.

My contribution focuses on the electrical side of the climbing system: battery management, power distribution, and the N20 motor-control architecture that keeps the robot climbing reliably under load.

The project is still in active development, with ongoing iteration on power efficiency and climbing stability.
features: Magnetic-wheel drive for vertical lamppost climbing
Live surveillance video streaming from height
Battery management and power distribution design
N20 motor-control architecture for reliable climbing operation

projects.title: PulsePath
projects.shortDesc: Ongoing indoor navigation system for the visually impaired, combining UWB trilateration, A* pathfinding, and vibration-belt directional cues. Led a 6-person team.
projects.fullDesc:
PulsePath is an ongoing assistive indoor navigation initiative designed to help visually impaired users move through complex spaces with confidence.

As project lead of a 6-person team, I helped implement UWB trilateration using dual body-mounted modules for orientation estimation, paired with A* pathfinding for real-time route guidance on mobile. A vibration belt delivers directional cues so users can navigate hands-free without needing to read dense on-screen information.

On the hardware side, I designed and fabricated a custom motor-driver PCB, and built a Flutter-based operator interface that gives real-time positional feedback during trials.
features: UWB trilateration with dual body-mounted modules for orientation estimation
A* pathfinding for real-time mobile route guidance
Vibration-belt directional cues for hands-free navigation
Custom motor-driver PCB design and fabrication
Flutter operator interface with real-time positional feedback

projects.title: WBGT Solar Panel Monitor
projects.shortDesc: Portable, solar-assisted WBGT monitoring prototype for outdoor heat stress awareness, sized for standalone Army field sensor deployment.
projects.fullDesc:
This project focused on building a field-ready WBGT monitoring prototype powered with a compact solar panel and portable tripod setup.

The device was designed for outdoor use to support quick environmental readings where heat stress risk matters. I sized the solar-LiPo power system specifically for standalone Army field sensor deployment, where personnel need fast, reliable heat stress indicators during prolonged operations without access to mains power.

The enclosure and mounting were iterated for stability, portability, and practical setup during on-site testing. The final prototype combined sensing hardware, power management, and product-form considerations into a compact demonstrator that could be deployed in real-world conditions.
features: Portable tripod-mounted monitor form factor
Solar-assisted power for longer outdoor usage
Weather-aware prototype for WBGT readings
Rapid setup for field validation and demos

projects.title: Verbasense
projects.shortDesc: Smart phone-holder classroom signal that listens for confusion-related language and shows class understanding levels through color.
projects.fullDesc:
Verbasense is a smart phone-holder concept for classrooms that helps teachers understand class comprehension at a glance.

The system listens to student conversations and detects confusion-related words and phrases. Instead of only tracking hand-raising, it reflects the overall understanding level of the class by changing color, giving teachers a quick visual indicator during lessons.

This approach helps instructors identify when to slow down, clarify concepts, or revisit key explanations without interrupting the flow of teaching.
features: Confusion keyword detection from classroom conversations
Color-based understanding indicator for fast teacher feedback
Phone-holder form factor for easy classroom placement
Real-time classroom sentiment reflection

projects.title: DIY Variable Capacitor
projects.shortDesc: Custom disk-style variable capacitor designed and 3D printed using Fusion 360.
projects.fullDesc:
A disk-style variable capacitor designed entirely in Fusion 360 and fabricated using additive manufacturing techniques.

The design allows capacitance to be adjusted mechanically by rotating the disk array, enabling fine-tuned control for use in electronics experiments and RF circuits. Every component was designed from scratch with precise tolerances to ensure reliable electrical performance.

This project was an exploration into bridging mechanical design with electrical engineering fundamentals.
features: Adjustable capacitance via disk rotation
Fully 3D printed structure
Designed from scratch in Fusion 360
Suitable for RF circuit experiments

projects.title: IADL Touchscreen Assessment System
projects.shortDesc: Projector-camera vision system for a touchscreen interface simulating IADL tasks, capturing interaction data via a force sensor glove.
projects.fullDesc:
This project built a projector-camera vision system driving a touchscreen-style interface for simulating Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADL) tasks, such as table wiping, for clinical assessment purposes.

A force sensor glove captured interaction data during task performance, giving therapists and researchers quantitative insight into a patient's movement and force application alongside the projected interface.

The work contributed to a provisional patent filing.
features: Projector-camera vision system for touchscreen task simulation
Force sensor glove for quantitative interaction data capture
IADL task simulation (e.g. table wiping) for clinical assessment
Contributed to a provisional patent filing
